one_line: Anthropic readies IPO with massive compute spend, AI firms raise billions, research breakthroughs appear, safety actions grow.

themes.title: Anthropic readies IPO with compute spend
themes.text: Anthropic disclosed $895 billion in compute commitments and a 1,100% revenue surge, while noting slower growth ahead of its planned listing.

stories.headline: Anthropic reports $895.4 billion in compute‑related purchase commitments and leases
Anthropic reports 1,100% revenue surge ahead of IPO, commits $895B to compute
Anthropic revenue growth slows as compute financing risks rise ahead of IPO

themes.title: AI firms secure billions for growth
themes.text: Oracle announced $20 billion in stock and bond sales for AI data centers, Alphabet sold €6 billion in bonds, Salesforce agreed to acquire Cresta for $2.7 billion, Tutor Intelligence raised $75 million for robot model training, 42AI secured $62.5 million seed funding, Lumen and Microsoft expanded co‑selling for AI‑ready networks, and OpenAI launched a Grid Protectors program with utilities.

stories.headline: Oracle to raise $20 billion via stock and bond sales for AI data centers
Alphabet launches €6 billion euro‑denominated bond sale, €17 billion demand
Salesforce to acquire Cresta for $2.7 billion
Tutor Intelligence raises $75 million Series B to expand robot model training and deployments
42AI emerges from stealth with $62.5 million seed to build behavioral world model
Lumen and Microsoft expand co‑selling to deliver AI‑ready enterprise networks
OpenAI launches Grid Protectors Program to aid utilities with compute campus power reliability

themes.title: New AI research applications
themes.text: An Anthropic‑based Claude agent selected a gene‑therapy vector and performed a precise brain injection in a mouse, GPT‑6 Astra edited a small fraction of Qwen3.5 weights to boost math performance sixfold, and OpenAI released the LifeVal benchmark to evaluate AI assistance on everyday tasks.

stories.headline: AI agent selects gene therapy and performs brain injection on live mouse
GPT-6 Astra edits 0.016% of Qwen3.5-0.8B weights, boosting math performance sixfold
OpenAI launches LifeVal benchmark for AI assistance with everyday tasks

themes.title: Legal and safety actions rise
themes.text: The New York Times and other publishers sued Brave for alleged AI scraping and paywall bypass, while OpenAI increased bug bounty rewards and added new researcher bonuses to strengthen security.
